entries.subject: Kreidberg et al. 2018 released three-dimensional atmosphere
entries.finding: Seven exact pressure slices of the 64 longitude by 30 latitude by 53 pressure grid. The 0.11542-bar extrema (923.14 and 3359.4 K) match the paper section 6. Source is the Drag3-named table read by the authors Figure 8 script; the paper describes this comparison as tau_drag = 10^4 s. No figure digitization, new fit or new GCM run.

entries.subject: HST and Spitzer observation-fitted thermal maps
entries.finding: Included on 2026-10-15 as the Hubble (default) and Spitzer 3.6 um datasets. The paper's table of model comparisons ranks the degree-2 spherical-harmonic temperature map best for the WFC3 white light curve and Spitzer 3.6 um (Delta BIC 0); at 4.5 um the two-temperature map is preferred by 2, so 4.5 um is not drawn. The coefficients come from the runs the paper's figure scripts load (Figures/WFC3_best_fits/bestfit_spherical.pic, Figures/Ch1_best_fits/2018-02-07_14:28-spherical); evaluated by SPIDERMAN with thermal=True they give back the table's T_min and T_max within 1 K (1227 and 3238 K; 1269 and 3391 K). Their area means are about 100 K from the table's day and night means, whose averaging the paper does not state. A measured map ranks above the simulation, which stays as the Temperature datasets.
entries.revisitWhen: A comparison between simulated and observation-inferred temperature is requested.

entries.subject: Barros et al. 2022 tidal deformation
entries.finding: CHEOPS infers deformation at 3 sigma. The selected GCM solves on a sphere; stretching it to a separate inferred ellipsoid would change its spatial interpretation.
entries.revisitWhen: A dataset with a matching deformed geometry is selected.

entries.subject: Latitude coverage of released GCM table
entries.finding: The released file stops at +/-81.562 degrees. No extrapolation into the polar caps; these are gray in every slice.
entries.revisitWhen: The authors release the missing polar rows or a documented continuation.
